source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Census apportionment — resident population by state
transformations: emp_total = sum of occ_state.emp per state
notes: POPULATION SHARE PROXY FOR EMPLOYMENT SHARE; replace with OEWS state ingest (ingest/oews.py). state_share = 2020 Census apportionment resident population / 331,449,281 (50 states + DC). Same occupational mix in every state.
